description: Fictional circular for brokers that offer algorithmic trading to retail clients; the Acme profile does not say whether it does.

document.title: Safeguards for Retail Algorithmic Trading Facilities Offered by Stock Brokers
document.content:
FICTIONAL DEMO CIRCULAR — NOT AN ACTUAL SEBI PUBLICATION.

To,
All Stock Brokers offering algorithmic trading facilities to retail clients.

Sub: Safeguards for Retail Algorithmic Trading Facilities Offered by Stock Brokers

1. Stock brokers that provide application programming interface access or algorithmic order placement to retail clients shall register each algorithm with the stock exchange and tag every algorithmic order with the exchange-assigned algorithm identifier.

2. Such stock brokers shall implement an order-per-second throttle per client, approved by the exchange, and shall maintain a kill switch that can halt all algorithmic orders of a client within one minute.

3. These provisions apply only to stock brokers offering algorithmic trading facilities to retail clients and come into effect on December 1, 2026.

4. Issued for demonstration purposes only.
